title.zh: 修正第61号法的法案，该法授权在本格特省修建波索鲁比奥至碧瑶公路，并废止作为其补充的第68号法
title.en: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED SIXTY-ONE, AUTHORIZING THE CONSTRUCTION OF A HIGHWAY FROM POZORRUBIO TO BAGUIO IN THE PROVINCE OF BENGUET AND REPEALING ACT NUMBERED SIXTY-EIGHT SUPPLEMENTARY THERETO.
title.orig: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED SIXTY-ONE, AUTHORIZING THE CONSTRUCTION OF A HIGHWAY FROM POZORRUBIO TO BAGUIO IN THE PROVINCE OF BENGUET AND REPEALING ACT NUMBERED SIXTY-EIGHT SUPPLEMENTARY THERETO.
title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi Đạo luật số 61 về việc xây dựng đường cao tốc từ Pozorrubio đến Baguio tại tỉnh Benguet và hủy bỏ Đạo luật số 68 bổ sung
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่61ว่าด้วยการก่อสร้างทางหลวงจากโปโซรูบิโอถึงบาเกียวในจังหวัดเบงเกตและยกเลิกพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่68ซึ่งเสริมเพิ่มเติม
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Undang-Undang Nomor 61 tentang pembangunan jalan raya dari Pozorrubio ke Baguio di Provinsi Benguet serta mencabut Undang-Undang Nomor 68 sebagai tambahan
title.ms: Akta mengubah Akta Nombor 61 mengenai pembinaan lebuhraya dari Pozorrubio ke Baguio di Wilayah Benguet dan membatalkan Akta Nombor 68 sebagai tambahan

text.en:
Section one of Act Numbered Sixty-one is hereby amended by striking out the words "Military
Governor" in line five and substituting therefor the words "Civil Governor" and by striking out the words
"Captain Charles W. Mead, Thirty-sixth Infantry, United States Volunteers, who has been detailed by the
Military Governor for that purpose" and substituting therefor the words "a civil engineer to be appointed by

The Civil Governor shall have power to appoint or designate a disbursing officer to disburse the
funds appropriated and unexpended for the construction of the Benguet road, and the location of the railroad
Act Numbered Sixty-eight is hereby repealed.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, August 13, 1901.
